note: Written by `node packages/mobile/src/boundary/cli.ts`; classes from the analyzer native facts (handler statements and their gaps).

locals.what: local names inside a handler (`const x = ...`)

ownFunction.what: a call to your own function, inlined at build time

sharedMethod.what: a method of `shared()` state, inlined at build time

callbackArgs.what: calling a received callback with arguments, or `?.()`

fieldWrite.what: writing a field of a state object or list row (`row.done = true`)

dates.what: dates, the clock and locale formatting

keyedRead.what: reading a key chosen at run time (`map[key]`)

browser.what: the page itself: DOM elements, `document`, `window`, browser classes and DOM type tests

objects.what: values of unknown shape: class instances, your own classes, objects a library or another module hands back

closure.what: a function passed or kept as a value (a closure)

recursion.what: a function the build cannot follow (recursive or deeply nested)
